description:
£135 PPPW - My Property Box are delighted to bring this three bedroom student property to the rental market, offering excellent value for money in the popular area of West Jesmond.

Ideally situated close to West Jesmond Metro station, the Lonsdale pub and Sainsbury-s, the property is perfectly positioned for students looking for convenient access to local amenities and transport links.

This well-maintained upper-floor flat features three generously sized double bedrooms, laminate flooring throughout, a good-sized living room and a bathroom fitted with a shower cubicle. The spacious layout provides a comfortable and practical living environment for a group of students.

Early viewing is highly recommended to avoid disappointment. To arrange a viewing, contact My Property Box today!
